event: 2025 ILCA U 21 Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: Panel of the International Jury was composed under RRS 1.4(b)
facts: The request for redress was submitted on the 22th of October at 16:54 for the incident that happened on the water on 21st October.
conclusions: ISR 224010 did not lodge the request as soon reasonably possible as required by RRS 61.2(b)(3).
The protest committee has no good reason to extend the time limit.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
